name: At the CA's desk
blurb: How a CA actually runs GST compliance for clients: the monthly filing cycle, what happens when a deadline is missed, fixing mistakes after filing, and handling notices from the department.

name: Foundations of GST
blurb: Why GST exists, the dual structure of CGST, SGST, UTGST and IGST, what it replaced, what stays outside it, and how the GST Council works.

name: Meaning and scope of supply
blurb: What counts as a supply, the schedules that stretch or shrink that definition, composite versus mixed supplies, and intra-state versus inter-state.

name: Place of supply
blurb: The rules that decide which state gets the tax, and therefore whether you charge IGST or CGST plus SGST. The single most tested area in GST.

name: Time and value of supply
blurb: When the tax liability arises and on what amount: invoices, advances, reverse charge timing, discounts, related parties and valuation rules.

name: Input tax credit
blurb: The credit mechanism that makes GST a value-added tax: conditions, time limits, blocked credits, reversals and the order in which credit is used.

name: Reverse charge
blurb: When the buyer pays the tax instead of the seller: notified goods and services, imports of services, self-invoicing and e-commerce operators paying as supplier.

name: Registration and GSTIN
blurb: Who must register, thresholds, the registration process, what each part of a GSTIN means, amendments and cancellation.

name: Composition scheme
blurb: The simplified scheme for small businesses: who qualifies, the rates, what they can't do, and how they file.

name: Invoices and documents
blurb: Tax invoices, bills of supply, credit and debit notes, vouchers and delivery challans: what each must contain and when it must be issued.

name: Returns and filing
blurb: GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, the annual return and the rest: what goes in which table, due dates, QRMP, sequencing rules and late fees.

name: E-invoicing
blurb: How invoices get registered on the IRP: applicability, IRN and QR codes, the JSON schema, cancellation, time limits and exemptions.

name: E-way bill
blurb: The document that must travel with goods: when it's needed, Part A and Part B, validity, extensions, cancellation and what happens without one.

name: Reconciliation and IMS
blurb: Matching your books with what suppliers reported: GSTR-2A versus 2B, the Invoice Management System, mismatch types and the rules that flag gaps.

name: Payments, ledgers and interest
blurb: How tax actually gets paid: the cash and credit ledgers, challans, interest, late fees and what credit can and can't pay for.

name: Exports, SEZ and refunds
blurb: Zero-rated supplies, LUT versus paying IGST, export of services conditions, SEZ supplies, deemed exports and how refunds work.

name: TDS, TCS and e-commerce
blurb: Tax deducted by government buyers, tax collected by e-commerce platforms, and the special rules for selling online.

name: Classification and rates
blurb: HSN and SAC codes, how many digits you need where, how goods get classified, and how rate changes flow through.

name: Assessment, notices and appeals
blurb: Scrutiny, audits, demand notices, penalties, the appeal ladder and advance rulings. What happens when the department comes asking.

name: The GST tech ecosystem
blurb: GSTN, the portals, GSPs and ASPs, APIs and the plumbing that compliance software is built on.

name: Terms and abbreviations
blurb: The vocabulary: acronyms on the portal, legal definitions that decide outcomes, and words that sound alike but aren't.
